WhyAtsIA.title: Why choose an AI ATS over a classic ATS?

WhyAtsIA.highlight: surfaces relevant applicants beyond keyword matches
WhyAtsIA.bodyMiddle: not words. Using natural language processing, our algorithm understands the context of experience, detects soft skills and identifies transferable skills. Result:
WhyAtsIA.bodyEnd: because of a simple wording variation.
WhyAtsIA.savingsDesc: Automate job writing, CV screening and interview preparation so you can focus on speaking with candidates.
WhyAtsIA.costDesc: Centralize the hiring process in one tool and reduce time spent on manual tasks.
WhyAtsIA.qualityDesc: Review skills, experience and points to explore before every interview.
WhyAtsIA.trustDesc: Seeklon centralizes applications and generates interview guides while applying data minimization, traceability and control principles.

FAQ.q2: How long does it take to get started?
FAQ.a2: Getting started is fast: you can request a demo, test the beta flow and begin with a first job opening in minutes.
FAQ.a3: No. AI helps rank applications and prepare interviews. The final hiring decision remains human.

Google Analytics audience measurement is optional and is only enabled after your consent through the cookie banner.
